subject: FORGE FINALE -- 30/45, C3.5 closed, real OOS leak found
body:
FORGE FINALE -- 30/45. Nine sessions today, six criteria earned.

Since the last note: C3.5 closed, and closing it found a real leak in the biggest split in the system. The boundary between the training window and the out-of-sample window reserved a flat 120 bars, and the comment beside it said "zero leakage". But each regime's exit horizon is chosen from a list that goes up to 150 bars, and a trade's outcome resolves over that horizon -- so any regime calibrated past 120 had its TRAINING outcomes resolving inside the out-of-sample window. That is the one measurement the whole arm decision rests on. The gap is now derived from the longest possible outcome window plus a margin, and there are 23 assertions checking it -- including negative controls, so the checks can actually fail rather than just agreeing with me.

Purging is also now applied to the four splits inside the weight search, where none of it existed before.

Then the long tail: rate reports that print a win rate without saying how many trades it came from went from 34 of 119 carrying their count this morning to 104 of 119 tonight. Most of that came from one small fix -- the risk layer was computing its win rate from a real sample and then throwing the count away, so a dozen scattered log lines could tell you the rate and none could tell you what it was measured over.

One thing got WORSE-looking on purpose: the floor-guard audit now reads the counts we just added instead of guessing, and with that it can judge many more lines -- most of which turn out to have no sample floor at all. 12 unguarded became 34. The picture got worse because the measurement got honest.

Six builds shipped today, SLS(173) through (178), each 0 errors 0 warnings, byte-identical across all three locations, terminal never running. Still Sunday, still nothing live possible.

15 criteria left. Next terminal-free work: the last 15 rate sites, then deriving the sample floor the guard audit needs.
